name: Web Alchemy Image Carousel
author: webalchemy

sections.description:
Create a reusable carousel from images already in your WordPress media library.
Publish the carousel, then add its shortcode to a page, post or shortcode-capable widget.

  • Add, reorder and remove images using the media library and keyboard-operable buttons.
  • Set captions, optional HTTP(S)/relative links, card width, image height and spacing.
  • Native horizontal scrolling stays available without JavaScript. JavaScript adds Previous/Next and Home/End controls without cloning slides or hiding links.
  • Supports right-to-left layouts, multiple carousels and the visitor’s reduced-motion preference. It never advances images automatically.
  • WordPress supplies image sizes and responsive srcset. Alternative text comes from the media library, with the caption as a fallback.
  • No account, activation key, tracking, remote requests, expiry or upgrade requirement. No plugin-imposed carousel or image quota; normal server request and memory limits apply.

Separate paid version

WA Seamless Slider is our separate commercial plugin with WooCommerce product/category sources, autoplay with pause and cyclic scrolling. Those features are not bundled or locked in this Free plugin. The optional product link appears only on this plugin’s editing screen. Free carousels continue to work without purchasing Pro.

The two plugins can run together and use separate post types, shortcodes and settings. Existing paid licenses are unchanged. Automatic conversion of a Free carousel into a Pro carousel is not included. Subscription checkout is not provided by this plugin; refer to the current offer on our website.

Limits

This plugin uses images from the media library, not automatic product feeds, external image URLs, videos or remote services. Publishing a carousel does not create a standalone public gallery URL. Draft, private, password-protected and empty carousels do not render through the shortcode. Uninstalling the plugin preserves its carousel records and media; delete unwanted carousels through WordPress first.

sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Open Image Carousels > Add New, enter a title and add media-library images.
  3. Set captions and optional links. Publish the carousel.
  4. Insert [web_alchemy_carousel id=”123″] into a Shortcode block, replacing 123 with the carousel’s actual ID.

WordPress 6.5+ and PHP 7.4+ are required. WooCommerce is not required for the Free plugin.
sections.faq:
Is this a trial?

No. The included image-carousel functionality is permanently free without activation or a quota.

Does it send data to Web Alchemy?

No. This plugin makes no remote requests and contains no analytics. The optional Pro link opens the public product page only when clicked.

Does it work without JavaScript?

Yes. The images, captions and links remain in the page and the gallery can be scrolled natively. Extra arrow controls appear only after JavaScript initializes.

Can I keep the paid WA Seamless Slider installed?

Yes. Its settings, shortcodes and licenses are separate. The Free plugin does not activate, unlock or alter paid functionality.

Where is image alternative text configured?

In the WordPress media library. If no alternative text is set, the slide caption is used. Add meaningful alternative text to informative images.
